# ADHX

> ADHX is a self-hosted, private feed for one group of close friends and family. Members save posts from fourteen social networks (X, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, Reddit, LinkedIn, Vimeo, SoundCloud, Pinterest, Twitch, Threads, Imgur and Bluesky); the server keeps a copy of each post's media and plays them in one feed. Almost everything on an ADHX server is for its members only. This file lists the few things anyone can read.

## Public pages

- [Post previews](/{username}/status/{id}): an X post in the theater, with Schema.org JSON-LD (SocialMediaPosting), Open Graph tags and semantic HTML. Instagram is at /p/{id} and /reel/{id}, TikTok at /@{username}/video/{id}, and the other networks at /s/{network}/{id}.
- [Public channels](/t/{username}/{tag}): a channel its owner made public, playable by anyone. The curator's profile is at /t/{username}.
- [Right now](/now): the moments people on this server are saving, with counts only and never who saved what.

## Public JSON

- [Post JSON](/api/share/tweet/{username}/{id}): an X post's author, text, engagement, media, article content as markdown, quotes and links. Not cached, so moderation is checked every time. When citing a post, link to its preview page, not this JSON.
- [Channel JSON](/api/share/tag/by-name/{username}/{tag}): the posts in a public channel.

## Your own saves (access key)

- [Search your saves](/api/agent/search): `GET /api/agent/search?q=&type=all|videos|photos|text|articles&limit=&offset=` with `Authorization: Bearer adhx_…` (a personal access key from Settings). Finds the key owner's own saves by meaning. Read-only; never anyone else's saves. See the [adhx skill](https://github.com/itsmemeworks/adhx/blob/main/skills/adhx/SKILL.md).

## Privacy

- Public pages and JSON never name who saved a post. Members see each other's names; strangers never do.
- A save marked "Just for me" never appears on a public page.
- Activity, trending and analytics feeds are for the server's admins only.
- Human-readable policy: [/privacy](/privacy) · [PRIVACY.md](https://github.com/itsmemeworks/adhx/blob/main/PRIVACY.md)
